data.title: 夜刀神十香 · 紫晶穹顶下的花嫁
data.description: 十香穿上为她准备的纯白婚纱，紫黑长发与大蝴蝶结在浮空花瓣间轻轻飘动；她把捧花举到鼻尖闻了闻，发现自己真的要走向誓约时，紫瞳里满是坦率而灿烂的期待。
data.location: crystal spirit cathedral above the city
data.action: 浮空花瓣间捧花闻香后迈向誓约，紫瞳里满是坦率期待
data.lighting: violet sunset filtered through crystal panels
data.mood: 纯真而热烈的誓约期待
data.promptProse: She holds the bouquet near her nose with both hands, smiling toward the offscreen viewer beneath the violet-lit crystal dome and floating petals.
data.animaCaption: She holds the bouquet near her nose beneath floating petals and the violet-lit crystal dome.
